name.ja: BB戦士 LEGENDBB 武者飛駆鳥 超鋼Ver.
name.en: BB Senshi LEGENDBB Musha Asukacho Super Steel Ver.

description.ja: 「ＬＥＧＥＮＤＢＢ 武者飛駆鳥」が豪華超鋼Ver.（スーパーハガネバージョン）で登場！！
description.en: "LEGENDBB Musha Asuka" is now available in a luxurious super steel version (super steel version)! !

description.ja: “金色の羽衣” を光沢のある金メッキで再現！全身が金色に輝く豪華な仕上がり！
description.en: The “golden coat” is reproduced with shiny gold plating! A luxurious finish that shines in gold all over!

description.ja: ●“金色の羽衣”は全て、キラキラ光沢金メッキ！
description.en: ●All “golden feathers” are glittering and shiny gold plated!

description.ja: 特徴的な装備である“金色の羽衣”は、全体を光沢のあるゴールドメッキのパーツで再現。
description.en: The characteristic equipment "Golden Feather" is entirely reproduced with shiny gold-plated parts.

description.ja: 両面にメッキ加工が施されており、“金色の羽衣”を纏うと全身が光り輝く豪華仕様。
description.en: Both sides are plated, and the luxurious design makes the whole body shine when wearing the "golden coat".

description.ja: ●武者飛駆鳥は、メタリック・パール成形を採用！
description.en: -Musha Asuka uses metallic pearl molding!

description.ja: 武者飛駆鳥は、白の部分はパール、赤・青・黒の部分はメタリックの成形色を採用。
description.en: Musha Asukacho uses pearl molding for the white part and metallic molding for the red, blue, and black parts.

description.ja: ●“鉄鋼迦楼羅＜メタルガルーダ＞”への変形を再現！
description.en: ●Reproduce the transformation to “Metal Garuda”!

description.ja: “武者飛駆鳥　金色の羽衣”から、“武者飛駆鳥”＋“鉄鋼迦楼羅”への変形を再現。
description.en: Reproduces the transformation from "Musha Asukacho Golden Feather " to " Musha Asukacho " + " Tetsuko Karura".
